correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs all identities directly: full-cube A^2=dI and square-zero rank N/2, puncture B^2=dI+bb^T with Bb=0, even-case rank B=N/2 and one J3, odd-case decomposition into J1(0) plus involution and exact J2(1) multiplicities. State-count formulas then follow from kernel and fixed-space dimensions; direct separate finite rank and complete-state programs check d=2..8 and five (d,q) cases. Finite tests are corroboration only.
